# OpenCC

`opencc.js` is the unmodified `dist/umd/cn2t.js` bundle from `opencc-js@1.0.5` (MIT license, included alongside it).
Source: https://github.com/nk2028/opencc-js
npm archive SHA-1: 4754a9407590c5d581c9b4788acd43e8627dd464

Used locally with `{ from: 'cn', to: 'twp' }` for Taiwan Traditional Chinese translations. Japanese source text and furigana must never pass through this converter.
